unit: Unit 12: Everyday Life with Your Computer
title: On this computer, or in the cloud?
drDigitalIntro:
Some things live on the computer in front of you. Some live on a company's computer and you reach them through a browser.
• On this computer: it works with no internet, but it is lost if the computer is lost.
• In the cloud: it works from any device you sign in to, but not without a connection.
• Neither is better. Most people keep working documents in the cloud and large private things locally.
• Sort the items below into where each one actually lives.

playgroundTask.instructions: Put each item where it lives. Click an item, then click a box.

items.label: A document you opened at Google Docs
A photo you just took, before you back it up
An email you can read on your phone and your laptop
A file in your Documents folder
A note in the Notes app you have not synced

drDigitalSuccess: That is the whole distinction. If you need it without internet, keep it here; if you need it everywhere, put it there.
drDigitalHint: Ask one question about each: could you open it with the internet turned off?
